from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A financial data point extracted from one document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the document")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year covered by this financial statement (e.g., '2023')")
    revenue_amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported revenue amount")
    revenue_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the document (e.g. 'Total Revenue')")
    document_period: str | None = Field(description="The specific statement period description (e.g. 'Fiscal Year Ended Dec 31, 2023')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
